summary: Documentation recheck after cycle 3 approved: the policy template and ADR-0019 still cover AC-017 to AC-019 and match the code; two low/info precision notes remain.
basis: Fix cycle 3 carried no findings and changed no tracked file. I re-read the acceptance packet section of templates/policies/spec-kit-workflow.md, ADR-0019 and the ADR-0006 note against packet.py. They agree on the file location and schema, the criterion-less repository table, the order and the 50 limit, the move-to-feature-file error (also for criteria = []), the agent-declared label, the head-commit screenshot and check rules, and migration. The installed docs/policies copy is correctly left for the next release pin. D-001 and D-002 need no user-facing documentation in this feature. The total-limit reason has no source prefix although both the policy and ADR-0019 say each reason names its source; an empty feature list renders None (0) without being described. The test check timed out after the last cycle, which stops the run for a human regardless of this verdict.

findings.label: spec-ambiguity
findings.reason: The policy and ADR-0019 say a UI reason names the failing source (ballast.toml: or ui-states.toml:), but 'more than 50 UI states' has no prefix, as AC-012 specifies. A short exception in both texts would make them exact.

findings.label: spec-ambiguity
findings.reason: A feature file with ui_states = [] renders None (0) rather than not configured. A test asserts this, but the policy does not describe it. The behavior matches the existing ballast.toml behavior.
